name: Firewater pumps, deluge/sprinkler system, hydrants and hose reels
description: Offshore firewater systems use self-contained firewater pump packages (vertical suspended deep-well/wet-pit or horizontal OH/BB types, diesel or electric driven) feeding fixed deluge, hydrants and hose reels. IOGP S-721 and NFPA 20 set performance and testing; Ramboll/NPD report describes deluge and firewater philosophy on unmanned WHPs. Primary source: https://jip33.iogp.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/Specification-for-Firewater-Pump-Package-S-721v2020-08.pdf
aliases: Firewater pumps, deluge/sprinkler system, hydrants and hose reels

specifications.metric: Firewater pump package (diesel or electr — Shutoff/deadhead pressure rise
specifications.unit: % of rated pressure at design conditions
specifications.basis: The shutoff or deadhead pressure rise shall lie between 110 % and 140 % of rated pressure at design conditions

specifications.metric: Firewater pump package (diesel or electr — Column pipe flow velocity at 100% rated flow
specifications.basis: column pipe flow velocity at 100 % rated flow not to exceed 4 m/s (13 ft/s)

specifications.metric: Firewater pump package (diesel or electr — Screens/strainer blockage allowance in submergence calculation
specifications.basis: Submergence calculations shall include 50 % blockage of screens or strainer area

specifications.metric: Firewater pump package (diesel or electr — Wave trough design return period for impeller submergence
specifications.basis: First stage impeller submergence for offshore pumps shall be the depth required to provide NPSH required by pump at end of curve duty point allowing for the specified 100 year wave trough depth

specifications.metric: Firewater pump package (diesel or electr — Diesel engine site-rated power margin
specifications.unit: % of maximum required pump kW at peak load
specifications.basis: Site rated engine power after NFPA 20 deductions shall be at least 110 % of the maximum required pump kW (bhp) at peak load, including gear and other transmission losses

specifications.metric: Firewater pump package (diesel or electr — Diesel engine proven field operating service
specifications.basis: Design and mechanical construction of diesel engines, accessories, and auxiliary system components shall have at least 24 000 hours of field operating service

specifications.metric: Firewater pump package (diesel or electr — Right-angle gearbox continuous operating capability
specifications.basis: Right angled gearboxes shall be capable of transmitting maximum power continuously for a minimum of 15 000 hours of operation

specifications.metric: Firewater pump package (diesel or electr — Coupling service factor - electric motor via gearbox
specifications.basis: A service factor of 1,25 shall be used for pumps driven by an electric induction motor via a gearbox

specifications.metric: Firewater pump package (diesel or electr — Coupling service factor - diesel engine via gearbox
specifications.basis: A service factor of 1,5 shall be used for pumps driven by a diesel engine via a gearbox

specifications.metric: Firewater pump package (diesel or electr — Gearbox oil temperature to bearings / return oil
specifications.basis: The temperature of the oil supply to the gearbox bearings shall not exceed 50 °C (120 °F); The temperature of the returning oil from the drain/sump ... shall not exceed the lesser of 80 °C (176 °F) or gearbox manufacturer’s maximum allowable oil temperature

specifications.metric: Firewater pump package (diesel or electr — Independent starting systems
specifications.basis: Engines shall be provided with two starting systems in accordance with NFPA 20 as primary and secondary starts

specifications.metric: Reliability — Uptime of simple unmanned platforms
specifications.basis: Types 2 and 3 have very a high availability (uptime) - in the range of 95% - 99.5%
